description.value: Dragon King is an authentic Chinese eatery on Highway 97 North in Kelowna specializing in freshly handmade dim sum alongside a broad menu of Cantonese-style dishes including hot pot, BBQ, and seafood. The restaurant offers bilingual service in English and Chinese and operates its own app with online ordering. Located on a major arterial route through Kelowna, it is a convenient stop for touring cyclists passing through the city.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website at dragonkingkelowna.com is fully accessible and confirms Dragon King is an active Chinese restaurant at 2435 Hwy 97 N, Kelowna BC V1X 4J2, phone 250-861-1305, with online ordering prominently featured across all pages. No cycling-specific amenities (bike parking, washrooms, Wi-Fi, charging) are mentioned anywhere on the site. OSM tags contain only name and amenity category with no contact details to cross-check.
concerns: OSM tags contain no address, phone, or email; all contact details sourced from website only.
Promotional banner references a March 31st discount end date with no year specified — minor staleness indicator but does not suggest closure.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, operating restaurant with an active website, confirmed address, and online ordering. Useful rest stop on Hwy 97 N for touring cyclists.

wow_evidence: freshly handmade dim sum alongside a broad menu of Cantonese-style dishes
